entries.title: Show HN: I asked an HN member for feedback and she blew my mind
entries.author: kabuks
entries.current_title: Show HN: I asked an HN member for feedback and she blew my mind
entries.excerpt: A few days ago, I responded to a comment by bloggergirl offering to read anyone's web copy and help. I shot off an email hoping for a paragraph or two of feedback on my startup's copy. Instead I received a professional, detailed deck of tons of invaluable well thought out feedback. It must have taken her an entire afternoon. Here's a link to it: http://www.slideshare.net/shereefb/recommendations-for-bettermeans To top it off, this isn't someone with a lot of free time on her
entries.guide_zh: 一位创业者分享 HN 成员为其网站文案提供的详尽反馈。

entries.title: Show HN: Review my project: MarkUp, a tool to draw on any webpage.
entries.author: senex
entries.current_title: Show HN: Review my project: MarkUp, a tool to draw on any webpage.
entries.excerpt: Here's the website: http://markup.io/ We created MarkUp at Medium to help make the QA process better for sites we're working on. Grab the MarkUp bookmarklet, go to some page in your browser, then click it to draw on the page. Publish to make a link you can share. We've tried similar tools like BounceApp, Notable, and Skitch. entries.guide_zh: MarkUp 让用户直接在任意网页上绘画标注，帮助交流页面问题与修改意见。
